subject.title: feat(ui): sessions sidebar redesign with agent sections, smart groups, and draft sessions

question: Should exec-node selection and gateway-managed worktree or custom-folder selection be mutually exclusive until node-local checkout routing is implemented?
rationale: The gateway provisions the worktree, while the current node execution contract does not inherit that gateway checkout as its default workdir, so the intended permanent UX cannot be inferred safely from code alone.

options.title: Make targets exclusive
options.body: Disable worktree and custom-folder controls when an exec node is selected, keeping the near-term UI truthful.

options.title: Add node-local routing
options.body: Implement node-owned checkout provisioning and workdir propagation before enabling combined targets.

options.title: Accept divergent behavior
options.body: Keep the combined controls even though node commands may run outside the displayed checkout.

recommendation.title: Make targets exclusive
recommendation.body: Disable worktree and custom-folder controls when an exec node is selected, keeping the near-term UI truthful.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the current sidebar/session history and the merged gateway contracts defining this product boundary.
